context.problem_statement: Analyze the survival times of patients using the mutated dataset `dataset.csv`. You must perform a Kaplan-Meier analysis to estimate survival curves and fit a Cox Proportional Hazards model to assess the impact of 'gender', 'body_mass_index', 'blood_pressure', and 'cholesterol_level' on survival times. Ensure you handle right-censoring appropriately. Report the median survival time, the p-value of the Cox model, and the hazard ratio for 'body_mass_index'. Provide a textual summary of your findings.
context.expert_knowledge: Survival analysis is crucial in biomedical studies where the time-to-event (such as disease progression or recovery) is of interest. Kaplan-Meier curves are used to visualize survival probabilities over time, while Cox Proportional Hazards models are used to assess the impact of covariates on survival times. Right-censoring occurs when the event of interest has not been observed for some subjects during the study period. Data scientists should be familiar with handling right-censored data, interpreting survival curves, and fitting Cox models.
